$comment: Recorded-mock fixture for the camara-gsma adapter (TelecomPort P13). AGGREGATE-ONLY, synthetic, no PII and no individual device tracking (Constitution Art. XIV; ADR-021). Shape is BEACON's canonical TelecomSignal[] (the anti-corruption output), NOT a raw CAMARA payload — the ACL maps CAMARA Population Density Data / Region Device Count / Connectivity Insights into this. Served when SOURCE_CAMARA_MODE=mock (the demo default, and the offline/air-gapped acceptance test). Region: a sample California cell (San Francisco Bay vicinity). All counts are coarse-bucketed and synthetic; do not treat as real measurements.

signals.note: Modeled connectivity drop consistent with infrastructure stress; advisory only, never auto-alerts (Art. XII/XIII).

provenance.license: Synthetic demo fixture (no upstream data; CAMARA API definitions are Apache-2.0)
provenance.attribution: Synthetic / aggregate-only. Not derived from any real subscriber data.
provenance.privacyNote: Aggregate-only by construction; no individual location, identity, or device is represented (Art. XIV; CAMARA min-aggregation / no-PII profile).
